notes.title: Multiplayer Demo Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[p][b]Wishlist Exile Protocol[/b] for Beta/Demo Announcements! ⬇️

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3235150/Exile_Protocol/#game_area_purchase"][/dynamiclink]
[b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]We’ve got exciting news – we’re hard at work on a [b]multiplayer demo[/b] for [i]Exile Protocol[/i]! 

In this upcoming demo, you and your friends will be able to dive into the [b]first three floors[/b] of the game, each with its own [b]unique biome[/b], [b]creatures[/b], and [b]atmosphere[/b]. This demo is shaping up to be [b]multiple hours of intense co-op gameplay[/b], and we’re getting close to the finish line.
[/p][p][b]What to Expect in the Demo:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Procedural generation[/b] – Every run is different, with randomized level layouts and creature types. No two playthroughs will be the same.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A variety of weapons[/b] – Test out multiple guns, complete with [b]scopes[/b], [b]laser sights[/b], and more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unique creatures[/b] – Encounter a wide array of enemies, each with distinct behaviors tied to their biome.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Three diverse floors[/b] – From eerie ruins to bio-labs crawling with mutations, get a taste of the world of [i]Exile Protocol[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p]We're super excited to get this into your hands. It’s just the beginning of what we’re building for [i]Exile Protocol[/i], and your feedback will be key as we push toward Early Access.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Make sure to Wishlist the game[/b] to get notified when the demo drops and when we launch our [b]Beta.[/b][/p][p]Make sure to follow us for gameplay clips, updates, and behind-the-scenes content:
